name: AdaniConneX Navi Mumbai data centre campus
summary: AdaniConneX lists a planned Navi Mumbai campus with a potential capacity of 1,000 MW of IT load, which the company says has not yet launched and will connect to the main internet exchanges over OPGW fibre. The company gives a ready-for-service date of December 2026 onwards and says the campus can use up to 100% renewable power. No address, investment figure, tenant or construction progress has been published in the sources reviewed.

location.note: The company names Navi Mumbai only. Coordinates are the OpenStreetMap Nominatim centroid of Navi Mumbai, not the site.

metrics.note: Listed by the company as potential capacity in IT load.

milestones.note: Company lists ready-for-service as December 2026 onwards.

power_sources.description: Company states up to 100% renewable energy; the supply arrangement is not described.

notes: Single source: the status comes from the company's undated campus page, accessed on 2026-10-09, so status_as_of is that access date. Status is announced because the page calls the facility soon to be launched and gives no construction details.
